title: roblox-3d-model
description: Generate game-ready 3D models for Roblox from text prompts, headlessly and end to end, one asset or a whole batch - text to a VERIFIED 2D concept image, image to a high-poly mesh with Hi3DGen (on Kaggle for volume, or a HuggingFace Space for one-offs), then headless Blender weld + decimate + UV + normal bake to a Roblox-legal MeshPart. GEOMETRY AND COLOUR BOTH WORK as of 2026-08-26 - colour is PAINTED procedurally into the UV atlas from a small JSON spec of stamps (paint_texture.py), which is exact and has no camera to align; the older concept-projection route still exists but smears and is only for assets that need the concept's actual markings. Assets go into Studio either with NO UPLOAD via AssetService EditableMesh/EditableImage (session-local, no credentials) or PERMANENTLY via a free Open Cloud upload as Model + Image (never Decal). batch.py chains the whole set: concepts, sheet, meshes, orient, paint, publish, studio - proven end to end. Use this whenever the user wants a Roblox mesh, prop, weapon, animal, crate, vehicle or any MeshPart generated rather than modelled by hand, wants a set of models made, wants an image turned into a Roblox model, asks about mesh triangle budgets, decimation, UV unwrapping or normal baking, or hits an asset upload that fails looking like a permissions error. Also trigger when a generated mesh is too heavy for Roblox, has no UVs, looks smooth and detail-less after being reduced, or when GPU quota is the thing blocking a batch of 3D genera Bundled SyphoDev reference; verify its steps on this machine.

title: roblox-map
description: Build and PROVE Roblox maps, levels and arenas headlessly from a JSON spec - greybox decks, cover, ledges, ramps, stairs, spawns, kill planes, and organic smooth-voxel terrain with beaches, cliffs, roads, caves and tides - emitting an annotated plan PNG, a physics-checked verification report, and either a Luau builder or an .rbxmx, all from ONE resolved tree so the plan cannot drift from what ships. title: roblox-sfx
description: Source, verify and wire the sound for a Roblox game from the Creator Store by asset id - footsteps, gunshots, animal calls, UI clicks, ambience, music - with no upload, no Open Cloud audio quota and no API key. Searches the same unauthenticated toolbox endpoints Studio's own audio tab uses, then PROVES each candidate in Studio (IsLoaded plus a measured Sound.TimeLength) before anything is chosen, because the toolbox's own duration field is wrong often enough to be dangerous. Emits a SoundBank data module, an Sfx runtime helper that fails inert, and an install script so the bank can be heard in an open place immediately. Use whenever the user wants sound effects, audio, SFX, music or ambience for a Roblox game, wants sounds found and wired rather than dragged in by hand, is picking audio for a build, or asks why a Sound is silent, has no length, or will not load in their place.
